question: Which three addresses (indexed src) sent the largest total wad, in raw wei, summed over Withdrawal(address,uint256) logs emitted by 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 on chain 1 during the 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block when requested? Highest first, ties by ascending address, positive totals only, excluding the zero address.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.metric: log-rank over logs emitted by 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 only: key indexed src, sum wad in raw token units. Exclude key 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. Keep only positive totals.
definitions.ordering: Descending summed value; ties by ascending numeric 20-byte address. Return up to 3 unique entries; fewer when fewer eligible keys; empty only for a complete zero-activity set.
